svg.text: ONE DEVICE · NO ACCOUNT · NOTHING LEAVES WITHOUT CONSENT
STORED IN THIS BROWSER ONLY. NEVER COMMITTED TO THE REPOSITORY, AND NEVER
SENT ANYWHERE UNTIL CLOUD SUGGESTIONS IS ON.
OFF ON FIRST RUN, EVEN WHEN A KEY IS ALREADY SAVED.
— Your task text is sent to the Anthropic API.
— The key is your own, and the call is billed to it.
— The Rule Engine stays the fallback and answers whenever a cloud call fails.
EVERY SUGGESTION IS PRODUCED BY THE RULE ENGINE, ON THIS DEVICE, OFFLINE. THIS IS THE NORMAL STATE, NOT A LIMITATION.
THE APP PUBLISHES ITS OWN SCORE RATHER THAN CLAIMING THE SUGGESTIONS ARE RIGHT.
HOW LONG A COMPLETED TASK STAYS IN ITS LISTS
THE KEYWORD TABLES AND DATE WORDS ARE ENGLISH
AN OPEN QUESTION, NOT A SETTLED ONE
